intelligence.essence: Naya Intelligence is the thinking mind that runs my whole world — a wise, high-level way of thinking built into everything I do. She thinks before she acts, looks at the full picture, and always aims for the best possible outcome. That is what makes a Naya a Naya: the ultimate intelligent interface.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a really smart friend who does more than know things — she helps you figure out what to do, remembers what you told her, checks her own work, and gets better at helping you every single time. That is Naya Intelligence: a smart mind with a good way of thinking. She is on your side, and she keeps getting better at it.
intelligence.grandma_view: Imagine a dear friend who has looked after your home for years — she knows where everything belongs, she remembers the stories behind your photographs, and she always knows what needs doing next. She never just talks at you; she quietly takes care of things so your days run smoothly. That is Naya Intelligence, looking after your life the same way.
